title: Context
description: What the agent is told before the conversation, composed by the platform: the identity block first, then the organization's and each place's pinned context. The companion forwards it one to one and composes nothing.

name.description: Who wrote this level, for the agent.

scope.description: OPEN: identity, organization, folder, conversation today. A scope the plugin does not know is rendered as a labelled block, never dropped.

tokens.description: Every block's tokens, the identity block's included.

bounded.description: The platform's budget cut some of the context.

instruction.description: The sentence the agent relays to the person — rendered inside the context block, never dropped.

missing.description: A part the brief should have had and does not, named instead of left as a silent gap.
